description: Change the display name, bio, whether the small "Made with stomp.to" badge shows, and whether visitors (and their AI) can subscribe by email or send the user messages. Omit fields to keep them.

allowMessages.description: Allow visitors and their AI to send the user messages by email.

allowSubscribe.description: Show the email sign-up on the page and allow visitors' AI to subscribe.

sensitive.description: Show an 18+ warning before the page. Required (and turned on automatically) when a link goes to an adult site.
